name: Microgrid reactive dispatch tracking monitor
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Compares assigned reactive-power demand with the measured contribution.
description: Compares assigned reactive-power demand with the measured contribution. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reactive request and measurement” at the input and “Reactive tracking error” at the output. Sign and measurement timing must match.

Show each measured quantity, target and resource capability limit.
